notes.content:

notes.title: We're part of the Steam Strategy Fest
notes.content:
[h3]Umbratica Tactics will participate in the upcoming Steam Strategy Fest![/h3]

We'll be releasing a new and updated version of our demo. This new demo will feature a very requested UNDO button, a rebalance for the probabilities of both the cards and relics, and improved UI and new animations for all the cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43830969/9add27bb1a3d10aa1e64e9f606b404bdb1b2ea18.jpg[/img]

[h3]Things to look forward to in this demo:[/h3]

[b]A very requested UNDO button:[/b] A lot of people have asked for the ability to undo a move that may have not been the best strategic decision. Now you can finally undo all the movement actions you want.

[b]Cards and Relics rebalance:[/b] Some cards and relics were appearing more often than others, so we rebalanced the probability for each card rarity, and now you feel more variety throughout the entire game.

[b]Improved UI:[/b] A LOT of fixes in readability and overall presentation of the UI in different sections of the game. Also, a lot of fixes in card, relic, and status descriptions to make everything easier to understand.

[b]New animations for all the cards:[/b] New animations, particles, vfx, and sfx for all the cards with the only purpose of delighting our players.


Remember to sign up for our [url=https://www.theatomiclife.com/mailinglist]Newsletter[/url] to keep up to date with all things Umbratica.
Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/cnmfHacF]Discord[/url] if you have any further questions about the demo.

notes.title: Combat Demo is finally live on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]The Pilgrimage has just begun![/h3]
Hi, everyone! After months of hard work we’re proud to announce that the first ever public demo for our roguelike turn-based tactics deckbuilder game Umbratica Tactics is finally live here on Steam!
[previewyoutube=9QK2UxDGe8U;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Are you ready to delve into the cursed land of Umbratica?[/h3]
This demo focuses on [b]combat[/b]. You’ll build your deck as you make your way through the City of the Damned in a series of battles against the unholy inhabitants of the night.
Yes, they are wicked, and yes, they are evil, but fear not, for this demo comes with [b]a very short (but optional) tutorial[/b] to teach you all you need to know to banish the evil that has taken over the once holy land of Umbratica.
Burn those fiends with sheer power of the Priest’s Thunder, or poison them to death with the Witch’s Rotten Breath. Split them them open with a Silver Bolt or bleed them dry the Hunter’s Axe.

Sign up to our [url=https://www.theatomiclife.com/mailinglist]Newsletter[/url] to keep up to date with all thing Umbratica.
Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/7W6HsNKD]Discord[/url] if you have any further questions about the demo.

notes.title: Welcome to Umbratica Tactics!
notes.content:
We're very proud and excited to announce a game that we've been working very hard for some time now: Umbratica Tactics. The game is a roguelike deckbuilding turn-based tactics game. You’ll lead a squad of vampire slayers as they fight their way through the cursed land of Umbratica in order to purge it from the evils that have taken hold of it. Craft a powerful deck, collect ancient relics and engage in deep grid-based tactical combat with an army ghouls, fiends and the other unspeakable monstrosities that inhabit the endless night that covers Umbratica.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43830969/2a305c544345e34f66ed6f733c6160ff1bd3762e.png[/img]

Here's a taste of what's inside the game:

[b]Precise no-RNG tactical turn-based combat:[/b] Deploy your squad of vampire slayers in a series of fast-paced grid-based combats. Purge this land from the ghouls, fiends and other deadly monstrosities that inhabit the night!

[b]Strategic roguelike deckbuilding:[/b] Your squad abilities are determined by your deck! So as you make your way through the cursed land of Umbratica you’ll gather new cards. You’ll use these as the attacks, actions and abilities of your squad in combat!

[b]Deeply customizable playstyle:[/b] As you play each run you’ll have several options over the way your squad fights. First you’ll the select the heroes that’ll go in your journey, each has their own set of available cards! As your journey progresses you’ll find different cards and you’ll upgrade them to further customize your playstyle, you’ll find powerful ancient relics that affect the functioning of the whole squad, and also mysterious items that can boost (and nerf) individual hero’s stats and also add special status during combat. Strategically combine all of these elements to fully express your playstyle!

[b]Roguelike run generation:[/b] Each time you dare to adventure into the gothic land of Umbratica the layout will be different. Different combat stages and rewards, different text-based events, different cards, relics and items. No two runs are the same!
